meta.name: optimization-loop
meta.description: The optimizer brain for the ladder-foundry pretraining loop. Runs the two-level nested batch loop, delegates gating to gate_eval, attributes a failing batch to one weight (attribute-first), and recovers from disk after compaction. Control flow is fully scripted; only the backprop attribution is a judgment call.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化预训练循环中的批次归因与恢复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在训练大模型并需要精细控制批次归因与恢复。
copy.tagline_en: Optimize batch attribution and recovery in pretraining loops
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you train large models and need fine-grained batch attribution and recovery.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会运行一个两层的嵌套批次循环（epoch/batch 和 per-run），生成研究设计样本。它委托门控决策给脚本，根据失败信号归因于一个权重，并从磁盘恢复状态。
howto.when: 当你开始一个训练运行（epoch）或处理下一个批次时触发。也可以在你要求检查门控或归因权重时进入。

say.text: 检查当前批次的门控结果。
say.note: 会调用 gate_eval 评估批次是否通过。

say.text: 为失败的批次归因权重。
say.note: 会执行 backprop 步骤，决策修改哪个权重。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude runs a two-level nested batch loop (epoch/batch and per-run) that produces labeled research-design samples. It delegates gating decisions to a script, attributes a failing batch to one weight, and recovers from disk after compaction.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you start a training run (epoch) or process the next batch. Also invoked when you request gating checks or weight attribution for a failed batch.

say_en.note: Triggers epoch start steps, generating a new run_id.

say_en.text: Check the current batch gating result.
say_en.note: Calls gate_eval to evaluate if the batch passes.

say_en.text: Attributing weight for the failed batch.
say_en.note: Runs backprop steps to decide which weight to modify.
